summary.notes: Operational incident inventory for YO Protocol's automated harvest swap failure. The public incident materials emphasize broken execution parameters rather than an external attacker; no definitive protocol contract address was surfaced in the excerpts collected during this research pass.

resolutionStrategy: Model this incident as an operational and routing failure rather than an attacker-driven exploit
Use the YO postmortem and SDK docs for protocol context while deferring onchain contract enumeration until a fuller deployment source is available
Allow empty contract coverage for now because the public source set was specific about the failure mode but not the exact contract inventory
